symptom: Re-running an already-applied alter snippet/alter page/alter layout printed "Altered snippet <name>" while every unit stayed byte-identical (no mtime change); sibling create-or-modify statements correctly printed Unchanged, so the run could not prove the second-exec-writes-nothing gate
cause: execAlterPage printed its report with fmt.Fprintf after mutator.Save(), so it announced the attempt, not the write; the pagemutator Save goes through SaveUnit, whose write elision (ADR-0008) is counted in backend WriteStats but was never consulted
insight: The elision evidence was already there: page/snippet/layout saves pass through counted unit storage, so swapping the hand-rolled Fprintf for ctx.ReportMutation("Altered", ...) is the whole fix. The settled-project copy reproduced the issue straight away because the reporting project had already applied the script: an old binary printed Altered with 0 md5 changes. A class-sweep grep for fmt.Fprintf write verbs after a Save()/Update* still finds unconverted handlers (alter workflow, alter flow, alter enumeration, agent-editor alters)
